python3 -c "
# March 31, 1950
max_1950 = 275000
outstanding_1950 = 255013
util_1950 = outstanding_1950 / max_1950 * 100

# March 31, 1955
max_1955 = 281000
outstanding_1955 = 273571
util_1955 = outstanding_1955 / max_1955 * 100

# Mean
mean_util = (util_1950 + util_1955) / 2

print(f'1950 utilization: {util_1950:.6f}%')
print(f'1955 utilization: {util_1955:.6f}%')
print(f'Mean: {mean_util:.6f}%')
print(f'Rounded to 2 decimals: {round(mean_util, 2)}')
"
